simple.summary: צוֹק (tsôwq) means a strait , i.e. (figuratively) distress First listed occurrence: Dan 9 25.

definitions.full: H6695. tsowq צוֺק noun [masculine] si vera lectio, constraint, distress ; — הָעִתִּים וּבְצוֺק Dan 9:25 usually in distressful times ; Gr וגו ׳וּבְקֵץ (so ᵐ5 [ 9:27 ] ᵑ6 ), as beginning of 9:26 , omitting וְ in וְאחרי (compare Bev Marti). צוּקָה noun feminine pressure, distress ; — national Isa 8:22 (+ צָרָה ), compare וְצ צָרָה ׳אֶרֶץ 30:6 ; personal וְצ ׳צָרָה Prov 1:27 .
